lessons.trigger_condition: V470 provided category-first one-detail navigation after interaction, but initial app setup only updated the category status and did not explicitly invoke the compact category-only visibility state.
lessons.prevention_rule: After category registrations and advanced-menu bindings are complete, invoke the existing fail-closed category reset once during initialization so every managed detail surface starts hidden until the user selects a category and function.
validation_required: initial setup calls updateCategoryStatus(null) followed by setCategoryContent(null)
all registered managed surfaces are hidden before feature selection
V470 category, one-detail, back, collapse and advanced-menu behavior remains unchanged
grading, market, collection and tablet runtime logic remains unchanged
lessons.safety_boundary: No new target is allowlisted, no grading/market/collection behavior is changed, no arbitrary selector or command execution is added, and CI does not claim physical Lenovo tablet verification.
